question: How many artists are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist

question: Which artist has the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the 5 genres with the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: Total revenue for each billing country
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS spend FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: What was total revenue in 2013?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013'

question: Total revenue per year
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY year

question: What is the name of the longest track?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees live in Calgary?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE City = 'Calgary'

question: List all media types
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: Which sales support agent's customers generated the most revenue? Give the agent's first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which playlists have no tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE pt.PlaylistId IS NULL

question: What is the average length in seconds of Rock tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: How many customers do not have a company listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NULL

question: What was our revenue last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2013-07-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2013-10-01'

question: How many tracks are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: How many customers are there in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: List the first and last names of customers from the USA
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA'

question: How many invoices were issued in 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

question: What is the average invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice

question: What is the largest single invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice

question: Which 3 genres earned the most revenue, from most to least?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many tracks are there for each media type?
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

question: List each employee's full name with the full name of the person they report to
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo

question: Which employee does not report to anyone?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NULL

question: Which albums have more than 20 tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

question: How many artists have no albums?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist ar WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album al WHERE al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId)

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

question: How many tracks does each playlist have? Include playlists with no tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId

question: Total revenue per month in 2012, in calendar order
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Which 3 billing cities generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCity, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCity ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which composer has written the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT Composer FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Composer ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which billing countries have total revenue over 100?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING SUM(Total) > 100

question: How many customers does each sales support agent look after? Give the agent's first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
